subject.title: feat(backup): add exclude patterns, --smart-exclude, and protected path guards [ai]

question: Should OpenClaw core accept backup exclude support here, and what default should maintainers approve for `.backupignore` loading and external asset filtering?
rationale: The PR changes backup contents, CLI/API surface, manifest output, and security-sensitive restore guarantees, so code review can identify unsafe implementation but cannot choose the product/security defaults alone.
